why: The pilot, 2026-11-06, after log 007 (v2.3.0 felt clunky, slow, brittle, convoluted): Sharknado becomes a Shabraz-first theme deck. Roughly 80% of lines go through Shabraz. Pure card draw grows him, and he is protected the moment he lands (shroud, ward, phase). Then he is made big, with double strike and with trample through Brallin's {R}, who is cast late. Cheap Humans that draw fly off Shabraz's {W/U}. Izzet cantrips, copy and storm effects chain draw spells. The discard and wheel side is held to about a fifth to a quarter of the deck, and every discard there comes with a draw.
